How to apologize
like a real man

1. Say "I was wrong"

No "but" after it.

2. Name what you did

Specific, not vague.

3. Don't ask for instant forgiveness

Give them time.

4. Learn why it happened

Understand yourself better.
Read, reflect, grow.

5. Change the behavior

The real apology is
not doing it again.
